title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Accounts Assistant

Clevedon - Office Based

Monday to Thursday 08:00-16:00, Friday 08:00-15:00

Up to £28,000 DOE

Excellent Benefits Package - Private healthcare, Dental care scheme, Bonus scheme, Permanent Health Insurance (PHI), 28 days holiday (Additional annual leave entitlement planned from January 2027!), Life assurance, Cycle to Work scheme, Early finish every Friday!

Are you looking to build your career within finance and accounting? Do you enjoy working with numbers, solving problems and being part of a supportive team? If so, we'd love to hear from you.

Our client is a well-established international engineering and manufacturing organisation, recognised as a global leader within its specialist market. Due to continued growth, they are looking to recruit an Accounts Assistant to join their friendly finance team at their UK Head Office in Clevedon.

Key Responsibilities
- Set up new customer and supplier accounts within Sage
- Process and record invoices and journal entries
- Set up payments through Barclays online banking
- Produce credit notes and support invoicing activities
- Monitor daily bank transactions and post entries to Sage
- Assist with general finance administration and record keeping
- Support the wider accounts team with day-to-day accounting activities

What We're Looking For
- Previous experience in an accounts, finance, or administration role is preferred
- Strong attention to detail and high levels of accuracy
- Good organisational and time management skills
- Confident using Microsoft Office, particularly Excel
- Experience of Sage 200 would be advantageous but not essential
- Excellent communication skills and a positive, team-focused attitude
- Self-motivated with a willingness to learn and develop

To apply, please submit a copy of your up-to-date CV indicating your relevant experience. Applicants must have an existing right to work in the UK, and evidence of eligibility will be required. Suitable candidates will be contacted.

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Accounts Assistant - Accountancy Practice - Taunton - £26,000 - £32,000

The people you work with can make all the difference to your experience in a new role. This accountancy practice has created a friendly and supportive environment, where colleagues are approachable and professional development is genuinely encouraged.

A successful accountancy practice, with an excellent reputation, is looking to recruit an Accounts Assistant to join its friendly and collaborative team in Taunton. Offering a varied workload, on-going training and genuine opportunities for progression, this is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to build on their existing accountancy practice experience.

As Accounts Assistant, your responsibilities will include:
- Assisting with the preparation of year-end accounts for sole traders, partnerships and limited companies
- Supporting the preparation of personal and corporate tax returns
- Preparing VAT returns and completing bookkeeping assignments
- Building positive relationships with clients and responding to day-to-day queries
- Working with cloud accounting software including Xero, QuickBooks and Sage
- Working closely with senior colleagues to deliver a high standard of client service

The successful Accounts Assistant candidate will:

Already have experience working within an accountancy practice and be keen to continue developing their technical knowledge.

You'll ideally be AAT qualified or studying towards a professional qualification, although candidates with strong practical experience will also be considered. Strong communication skills, attention to detail and a positive attitude will all be important in this role.

Joining this successful practice means becoming part of a friendly and experienced team where you'll be encouraged to develop your skills, broaden your experience and continue progressing your career within accountancy practice.

Please click apply to this Accounts Assistant vacancy, or contact Jay Vilarrubi-Smith for a confidential discussion, quoting reference JVS11265.

Trial Balance is a market leading supplier of recruitment services to accountancy practices across the South-West and works on vacancies at all levels in a practice environment. For a confidential discussion about your career options please contact Jay Vilarrubi-Smith, our dedicated practice specialist.
